alkylation_concentration.evidence: Samples were reduced with 0.1 M of dithiothreitol (DTT) and alkylated with 50 mM iodacetamide (IAA) before being digested in a filter unit according to the filter-aided sample preparation (FASP) procedure, adding trypsin to 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate in a 1:50 ratio.
